Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 2:00 PM, 05 September 2025(Friday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Zambales.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Nueva Ecija, Bulacan, Metro Manila, Rizal, Cavite, Batangas, Laguna and Quezon within the next 3 hours.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 5:00 PM today.

Apat na fire trucks ng Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP)-Manila ang agad na rumesponde sa lugar, ngunit pagdating nila ay walang sunog at maayos naman ang kalagayan ng naturang truck.

Lumabas na peke ang litrato at pinaghihinalaang gawa lang ng artificial intelligence (AI).

Umaasa ang Manila BFP na mapapanagot ang nagpakalat ng maling impormasyon.

Ayon naman sa Republic Act 9514 o The Fire Code of the Philippines, partikular ang Section 8 at 11, maaaring pagmultahin ng P50,000 ang sinumang mapatutunayang nagpapakalat ng “false or malicious fire alarms.”

#PilipinasToday
#BureauofFireProtection
#Manila

According to the Republic 9514 or The Fire Code of the Philippine, in particular Setion 8 and could be fined any more than one who is spreading the wrong fire file.
